text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: What, so you're sayin' it ain't perfect?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Just remember, this evaluation is a total consideration
of everyone's growth rate.
It's important to look at things mid-to-long term."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
The fact that the team members have started sharing techniques and knowledge among themselves is a very positive sign.
I believe your influence has played a particularly large role in that.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. If it helps me get stronger,
I'll do whatever it takes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her obsession with strength raises the quality of her training.
I need to come up with a solid plan so she can grow even more next season.
